bib.title: Unnatural Instructions: Tuning Language Models with (Almost) No Human Labor
bib.venue: Proceedings of the 61st Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2023), Volume 1: Long Papers, pages 14409-14428

read.skipped: Table 6 seed demonstrations (appendix C) skimmed only; they are copied from Super-Natural Instructions

question: Can a large, diverse instruction-tuning dataset be created by prompting a language model with almost no human labor, and does tuning on it match tuning on human-curated data?
hypothesis: Model-generated instructions, despite noise, give a training signal comparable to manually curated instruction data at far lower cost; paraphrase expansion should help on benchmarks with free-form formats.
contributions: Unnatural Instructions: 240,670 automatically generated instruction-input-output examples from 15 seed examples
Data analysis of correctness and diversity on 200 sampled examples
Fine-tuning of T5-LM 11B that rivals or beats T0++ and Tk-Instruct and matches a Super-Natural Instructions baseline, with cost and scaling analysis
Ablations of the generator model and prompt structure

method.summary: text-davinci-002 is prompted with 3 Super-Natural Instructions demonstrations to generate a fourth instruction/input/constraints (nucleus sampling), then outputs by greedy decoding, with 3 simple filters. Instructions are then paraphrased (two per example) to 240,670 examples. T5-LM 11B is fine-tuned on the data and compared with T0++, Tk-Instruct, FLAN-T5 and T5-LM trained on 64,000 Super-Natural Instructions examples.
method.task: instruction tuning with model-generated data (zero-shot generalisation)

datasets.preprocessing: up to five attempts per paraphrase; must contain {INPUT} placeholder; identical or copied reformulations rejected

inference.prompting: 3 in-context demonstrations (5 seed sets = 15 examples) with an enumeration meta-prompt; paraphrase prompt has 2 demonstrations; evaluation is zero-shot

limits: Dataset is noisy: 43.5% of 200 sampled examples had an invalid instruction, input or output (authors concede)
Only one student model (T5-LM 11B) and one main generator (text-davinci-002)
Core data copies Super-Natural Instructions format, so generalisation to other formats needs paraphrases
Main table seems to be a single run with no variance
Untuned GPT-3 fails at output generation (cannot stop)
No harm analysis beyond a manual look; code/data release not stated in text
Correctness annotation protocol is not described (human-participant checklist blank)
